ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-01.prompt: An isosceles triangle has a line of symmetry $y=3$ and two of its vertices are $(3,3)$ and $(5,2)$. What are the coordinates of the third vertex?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-02.prompt: A bat will snooze for 21 hours a day. For what percentage of the year is the bat not snoozing?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-03.prompt:
How many of these four statements are true?

1. There are five single-digit prime numbers.
2. The area of a square with sides 3 cm long is 0.09 m$^2$.
3. Two of the letters in the word CHIME have rotational symmetry of order 2.
4. $\frac78$ is smaller than $\frac89$.

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-04.prompt: A sequence consists of positive and negative integers in this pattern: $1,-2,-2,3,3,3,-4,-4,-4,-4,\ldots$ and so on, ending with $-8,-8,-8,-8,-8,-8,-8,-8$. What is the range of the numbers in the sequence?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-05.prompt: "For a laugh", somebody swapped the $+$ and $\times$ buttons on Matt's scientific calculator. Matt then punched in $2\times4\div12+6\times3$. What answer did the calculator give?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-06.prompt: What is the product of the mean and range of the numbers 2, 0, 1 and 7?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-07.prompt: A walker travels 2 km on a bearing of $090^\circ$ then 2 km on a bearing of $210^\circ$. On what bearing must she walk to return to her starting point?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-08.prompt: A path of width 2 m runs along two adjacent sides of a square flower bed, as shown. The area of the path is 72 m$^2$. What is the area of the flower bed?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-09.prompt: From the integers 1 to 100, all the multiples of 2, 3 and 4 are removed. How many of the original one hundred integers remain?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-10.prompt: The BBC Concert Orchestra has 125 members for a concert. The woodwind section is made up of three each of flutes, oboes, clarinets and bassoons, two piccolos and two cors anglais. What percentage of the orchestra is the woodwind section?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-11.prompt: Young Jack decides to become serious with saving his pennies. On 26 May he puts 1p into his piggy bank. The next day he puts 2p into the piggy bank and the day after he puts 4p into the piggy bank, and so on, doubling the amount he puts in each day. On what date does his piggy bank first hold more than £5?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-12.prompt: An integer sequence uses this rule to obtain the next number: "If odd, then multiply by 5 and subtract 3; if even, divide by 2". When I start with 14, what is the sum of the four smallest different integers in the entire sequence?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-13.prompt: A class of 28 pupils were asked about what they watched at the Rio Olympics. When asked "Did you watch some athletics?", three more said "yes" than when they were asked "Did you watch some gymnastics?", which was three more than the nine pupils who said that they watched neither athletics nor gymnastics. How many pupils watched ONLY gymnastics?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-14.prompt: Four positive integers have a median of 2 and a range of 3. Let $m$ be the mean of these four numbers. What is the sum of all the different values that $m$ could take?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-15.prompt: Pietro is trying out a road bike with wheels of different sizes; the circumferences of the rear and front wheels are 1.2 m and 1.8 m respectively. During a test race, the rear wheel does 150 more complete turns than the front wheel. How long is the race?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-16.prompt: Excited at the prospect of a bargain, Jane bought 24 books from a market stall advertising 3 books for £5 or £1.99 each. What is the difference between what Jane paid and the full price?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-17.prompt: What is the product of the median and range of the numbers 2, 0, 1 and 7?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-18.prompt: My horse, Ned, spends 95% of his time standing. For how many hours is he not standing this year?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-19.prompt: Harry and Martha set off on a 21 km cycle ride. Harry travels at a steady speed of 14 km per hour, and Martha at 12 km per hour. For how many minutes does Harry have to wait for Martha to arrive at the end?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-20.prompt: A survey taken by the deputy head on how many students ride to school every day received 504 replies. The deputy head draws a pie chart to show the 504 responses and shades $315^\circ$ as the sector representing "does not ride to school". How many pupils rode to school?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-21.prompt: Three of the coordinates of a square $ABCD$ are $A(20,10)$, $B(30,20)$, $C(20,30)$. The square is reflected in the $x$-axis. What are the coordinates of the centre of the reflected square?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-22.prompt: Cubes-R-Us, a firm that makes boxes, has increased the volume of its most popular box, the deluxe silk-lined jewellery box, by 80%. The old size was 5 cm $\times$ 6 cm $\times$ 2 cm. What is the new volume?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-24.prompt: Josh walks 35 metres on a bearing of $260^\circ$ then walks another 35 metres on a bearing of $140^\circ$. He then walks on a bearing of $y^\circ$ for $x$ metres, returning to his starting point. Calculate the value of $x+y$.

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-25.prompt: Julie has bought a small canister of helium for filling helium balloons at her party. On the side of the canister it says: "Will fill 24 large balloons OR 60 medium balloons OR 240 small balloons." Julie fills 9 large and 25 medium balloons. How many small balloons can she fill with the remaining helium?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-26.prompt: What is the difference between the product of the factors of 26 and the sum of the factors of 26?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-27.prompt: A sequence consists of positive and negative integers in this pattern: $1,-2,-2,3,3,3,-4,-4,-4,-4,\ldots$ and so on, ending with $-8,-8,-8,-8,-8,-8,-8,-8$. What is the median?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-28.prompt: Julie walks for 1 hour at 1 mph, then for 2 hours at 2 mph, then for 3 hours at $x$ mph. Her average speed over the entire journey is 2 mph. What is the value of $x$?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-29.prompt: A sequence follows this rule to obtain the next number: "If odd, then multiply by 3 and add 1; if even, then divide by 2". When I start from 14, what is the sum of the four smallest different numbers in the entire sequence?

ukmt-tmc-2017-regional-relay-30.prompt: A right-angled triangle travels along the line $AB$ as shown. It passes through a square of side 8 cm. What is the maximum area of the overlap?
